source.title: Use Positive Body Language, Such as Smiling, Maintaining an Open Posture, and Making Appropriate
source.subtitle: Use Positive Body Language
source.description: Use positive body language, such as smiling, maintaining an open posture, and making appropriate gestures. Avoid crossing your arms or looking away.

source.title: When Someone Behaves in a Way That Frustrates You, Try to Uncover the Positive
source.subtitle: Find the Positive Intention
source.description: When someone behaves in a way that frustrates you, try to uncover the positive intention behind their action. Ask, 'What positive outcome might they be trying to achieve?'

source.title: Start Your Day with Something Positive, Like an Uplifting Quote, an Inspiring Story, or
source.subtitle: Positive Priming
source.description: Start your day with something positive, like an uplifting quote, an inspiring story, or a funny video.

source.title: Notice Times When a Behavior Has a Positive Outcome, Like Getting Praise or Feeling
source.subtitle: Identify Positive Reinforcements
source.description: Notice times when a behavior has a positive outcome, like getting praise or feeling accomplished. Recognize these moments to reinforce positive patterns.

source.title: After Meetings or Conversations, Follow up with a Brief Email Summarizing the Discussion and
source.subtitle: Follow Up Effectively
source.description: After meetings or conversations, follow up with a brief email summarizing the discussion and next steps.
